finding.claim_axis: 80/160/320/560/1120 ms right-context operating points where supported by the exact runtime
finding.runtime_documentation: At pinned NeMo-Speech.cpp runtime commit, asr.streaming.chunk_size/--chunk-sec is documented as the CTC buffered window, while asr.streaming.rnnt_right_context is the cache-aware RNNT right-context control.
finding.interpretation: The comparator does vary the relevant RNNT control, but its receipt/config metadata names the mapped millisecond axis chunk_ms. Treating that field as a literal runtime chunk-size setting would be unsupported. The axis should be recorded as right_context_ms (or explicitly documented as a derived right-context latency label) before promotion-bearing execution is consumed.

next_exact_action: Before consuming an ASR008 execution receipt for promotion, make the comparator/validator schema distinguish rnnt_right_context from derived right_context_ms and reject receipts that present the field as literal chunk-size evidence. Then execute the unchanged pinned model/runtime subject and compare against the admitted ASR004 baselines.
scope_fence: This is a metadata/evidence-validity finding, not a Nemotron product-negative result and not proof that the RNNT geometry sweep itself is ineffective.
